title: Workout Join Labels
prompt: A workout export receives label parts. Write a function that joins the labels with the provided separator string.

explanation.beginner:
Example: workoutJoinLabels(["workout","daily","ready"], " / ") produces "workout / daily / ready". Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Compare “handles one label”: input [["solo"],", "] produces "solo". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Tempting mistake: A projection is different from filtering: returning a boolean from map gives booleans, while returning a value from filter only makes a keep decision.

The reference uses join. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “handles one label”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
